request.deadline: 18-month funding period with milestones from Q3 2026 through 2027
deliverables: Legally establish a not-for-profit entity or sign a host-organization agreement under the preliminary board in Q3 2026
Publish technical transition architecture and migration plan for community review in Q3 2026
Launch a public usage dashboard in Q3 2026
Hold a board election via on-chain voting under public rules in Q4 2026
Serve all public API traffic for mainnet, preview, and preprod from the new stack in Q1 2027
Legally transfer Blockfrost source code, trademarks, domain names, and associated assets to the governing entity in Q1 2027
Open public consultation and publish a long-term sustainability proposal in Q2-Q3 2027
Operate the public API at a minimum 99% monthly uptime SLA during 2027
Publish quarterly reports covering technical metrics and budget summary
request.recipient: Input Output / Blockfrost not-for-profit transition, with governance and administration involving Intersect/CDH as described
request.what: Transition Blockfrost into a free, community-governed public good under an independent community-governed not-for-profit and fund 18 months of transition and operations.

claims.claim: Blockfrost is described as a hosted REST interface that lets developers read from and interact with Cardano without running their own node infrastructure.
The proposal says Blockfrost developer-survey adoption rose from 39.3% in 2022 to 71.5% in 2025, citing Cardano Foundation survey links for each year.
The proposal states that last month Blockfrost served 781,000 unique visitors, more than 1.84 billion API requests, almost 700 requests per second, and over 7 TB of API data.
The proposal states that more than 50% of all Cardano transactions are submitted through Blockfrost in most epochs.
The proposal says more than 100 Icebreakers have joined the decentralized Blockfrost operator effort.
The proposal asserts that 90% of Cardano traffic served through the Blockfrost API comes from the free tier and that the commercial model has struggled to finance the public-good operation.

The proposal commits that all Blockfrost intellectual property, including source code, trademarks, domain names, and associated assets, will be transferred to the governing not-for-profit entity as part of the transition.
The requested budget is 9,832,979 ADA, equivalent to $1,868,266 at $0.19 per ADA, allocated to staffing, operations and infrastructure, and legal/accounting costs for 18 months.
The proposal says any unspent post-transition infrastructure budget will be returned to the treasury and that the board will publish quarterly reports with technical data and budget summaries.

The proposal says long-term sustainability options include paid tiers operated by the not-for-profit with profits returned to the Cardano Treasury or a vendor-backed model with membership fees and partner vendors.

summary: The document requests 9,832,979 ADA to move Blockfrost into community-governed not-for-profit ownership, transfer its IP, maintain a free public API, and operate the service for 18 months with governance, dashboard, reporting, uptime, and sustainability milestones.
